//: Copy to ~/.config/nimbus/config.json. Every key is optional; anything
you leave out uses the macOS default. Unknown keys are ignored, and a
bad value costs only its own setting, never the whole file.
// brightness: Baseline once the flare settles. The Mac menu's Subtle /
// band_width: inside and outside the window edge. The bloom scales with it.
// turbulence: smooth | normal | churny  — how fine the structure is.
// frame_rate: The setting that decides what this costs: cost is very
nearly linear in frame rate and almost independent of the
shader. Drop it on a slow machine or to save battery.
// palette_interval: Seconds between colour changes; 0 never rotates.
// exclusions: Window classes that never get a ring, e.g. ["mpv"].
Find one with: hyprctl -j activewindow | grep class
// when you are away: Seconds of no input before the ring stands down;
// idle_behavior: freeze | always_animate | fade_out. freeze is the default
and stops the animation while leaving the ring on screen:
walking back and seeing which window has focus, before
touching anything, is the case this exists for.
// flare_on_return: Pulse on the first input after being away.
// debug_mode: 0 off. 1 paints every drawn fragment blue. 2 also replaces
the ring with a full-screen quad, which separates "the
surface is not compositing" from "the ring draws nothing".
